old: The best per-dollar shape among the rows that are actually buyable today: 1 GB and 10 GB for EUR 11.99 a year is EUR 0.999 a month, and the plan carries a /52 rather than a single /128, which is enough for a routed subnet behind the guest. The catch is the IPv4 add-on: at EUR 2 a month it is 24 EUR a year on top of an 11.99 EUR plan, so converting this row to dual-stack triples it. Frankfurt is the only IPv6 rung in stock on 2026-10-24; Amsterdam and Toronto both read Out of Stock. Not established: the checkout fields, payment rails, any card hold, and whether the 'up to /52' is a routed prefix or a pool the panel hands out one address from.
